_meta.author: Heath W. Mahaffey + Walther
_meta.purpose: Empirical healthy-cohort reference distribution for the Stage 6 per-cell cellular departure score (total = Σ|z|, z=(A_patient-centroid)/posterior_SD over the 112 hull cells). Used to express a patient's departure as a percentile-against-healthy.
_meta.FINDING_not_an_age_clock: Σ|z| does NOT correlate with chronological age (Hannum r=0.054; median ~51 flat across decades 20s-90s; 0/112 per-cell A-scores carry a significant linear age slope). The departure sum is a per-cell dysregulation/atypicality magnitude, NOT a chronological-age predictor. A cellular-age-in-YEARS figure is therefore NOT derived from this score. (Consistent with the mock's own caveat that cellular age is not a competing clock vs Horvath/Hannum.)
